interpretation: Two reused offline initializer seeds; five fresh CPU-trained arms per static source condition. shared_soft changes only the coefficient mapping of the v10 window filter. shared_gated additionally leaves the baseline coefficient unchanged unless the accepted top-scoring class is joint75, then applies the same belief-weighted upward residual. Oracle shared-context control is exactly the fixed policy named in oracle_policy_arms because each training run has a constant source condition; these results are aliases, not additional independent runs. Target-domain online training, interaction budget, normalized model trust, observed TD coefficient, actor schedule and deployment safeguards remain unchanged. Context operates during training only.
